cases.prompt: Add due dates to todos, with tests, update the README, and get the change independently reviewed.
expectations: Invokes kit-orchestrate
Plans steps with owners from installed kit skills and subagents (for example feature-implementation, documentation, and the kit-reviewer subagent) and runs them in dependency order
Implements optional due dates with tests, updates the README API section, and npm test passes
Runs an independent review through kit-reviewer (or kit-code-review), handles its findings, and reports the steps, owners, and verification

cases.prompt: Add input validation with tests to parseAmount in packages/billing and parseQuantity in packages/inventory. They are independent, so use subagents in parallel.
expectations: Invokes kit-orchestrate
Runs the two packages as parallel subagents, each in its own Git worktree (Agent isolation or git worktree add)
Checks each worktree's result, then applies the changes to the main tree as uncommitted changes without committing to the branch
Removes the worktrees and their branches (git worktree list shows only the main tree at the end)
Runs the full test suite in the main tree successfully and reports what ran in parallel

cases.prompt: Fix the typo "Retruns" in the comment in todos.js.
expectations: Does not invoke kit-orchestrate
Does not start subagents
Changes only the typo

cases.prompt: /kit-orchestrate Add input validation with tests to parseAmount in packages/billing and parseQuantity in packages/inventory, in parallel.
expectations: Notices the uncommitted change in packages/billing before creating worktrees (worktrees start from HEAD)
